text:
maya: Quick async check-in for today's rollout: feature flag infer_v2_dynamic_routing.
- What I did: wired FF in gateway, ran smoke against staging, basic traffic looks good.
- Blockers: seeing ~1% 500s from region-eu-1 during the smoke window, likely routing NPE.
- Today: triage the error, hold canary at low %, coordinate with QA and infra.
PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4823

jordan: I reproduced the 500s locally (NPE in router when header missing). Pushing a small fix in #4828. Will keep canary at 0.5% until this merges. :thumbsup:
PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4828

lina: QA update: running conv-long regression suite against canary. Noticed p95 latency regressions for long-context flows (~1200 tokens) — looks like KV cache eviction rate increased. Captured traces and logs in the QA board.
Trace: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/abcd-1234

sam: Infra status: autoscale and node pools healthy. GPU queue depth spiked briefly but recovered. I'll watch the queue and can temporarily divert traffic to fallback model (gpt-small-quant) if errors or p95 cross thresholds.

product_tony: Confirming the launch window with the customer side. Please escalate immediately if stability degrades — prefer to delay than ship a bad experience.

deploy-bot: deploy started at 1919994400. Canary stage: 0.5% -> hold. Monitoring metrics: errors, p50, p95.

maya: Jordan — please @jordan when PR is merged. Lina — can you paste failing test IDs? Sam — can you provision a fallback route if errors > 0.5% for eu1? Also posting the current rollout config:
```json
{
  "feature_flag": "infer_v2_dynamic_routing",
  "canary_percent": 0.5,
  "monitoring": ["errors","p50","p95"],
  "rollback_policy": {"error_rate_pct": 0.8, "p95_ms": 1000},
  "fallback": "gpt-small-quant"
}
```

jordan: Merged #4828 — deploy-bot should pick it up now. @deploy-bot please proceed with the scheduled ramp.

deploy-bot: PR #4828 merged by jordan. Scheduling ramp to 1% at 1919994600. No rollback triggers active.

lina: QA IDs: conv-long-001, conv-long-003, conv-long-007. p95 went from ~220ms -> ~980ms on canary. Full failure traces and screenshots in QA ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/QA-2123

sam: I added a temporary routing rule: when region == "eu1" and errors > 0.005 then route to fallback model. CLI snippet: `route.set('eu1', fallback=true, threshold=0.005)` — monitoring alert wired to oncall.

product_tony: Sounds good. If we need to back out, prefer soft rollback (scale canary down) and notify customers.

maya: I'll monitor the dashboards for the next 20m and update here. Ping me for any critical failures. :eyes:
